needs.premise: 14 positive and 10 unsafe controls; one queued Tcl entry and pin, one parent epoch and one run cleanup. Opaque Tcl/run root contents, live owner/token and external drain/settlement are premises; not a shared-VM evaluator/ABI/weak-memory proof.
Conditional pin/delete lifetime, park/epoch, run return/cleanup/count and payload equations; selective operation laws, no complete QNT trace/source simulation.
Live token anchor, owner-thread callback entry pin before data_rc, deleteProc close without self-wait, preserve trace/replacement behavior and separate Command versus ClientData lifetime.
Every parent raw borrower stops, full map includes continuation/denv/native activation, context preparation and same-owner reload; no Tcl event pumping or duplicate call to avoid wait cycle.

Transfer registered startup/worker thunk origin before worker publication/read/synchronization, then root before marker; cover ___call rethrow and known marker failure with post-END_TRY canonical cleanup; source data_scmobj alone is not root coverage.
One custodian records marker initialized/cleared/count drop and root/status transfer; preserve setjmp-defined state, original error, frame/catcher and unknown-progress custody.
Actual Tcl version/installed match, trace reentry, queued/raw dispatch and reentrant CreateCommand installation/discard paths; no drain inferred from zero active entries.
Concrete lock/lifetime/read-from, release/acquire park/reload, effect-qualified marker stores and scanner/root registry order; no native C refinement receipt.
First future source slice spans ___run plus activation-root/scanner/marker contracts; not kill-only repair or unconsumed API. Scheme SFUN generator and Tcl adapter have explicit later gates.

Mapped parent source lease exists before foreign export; child acceptance covers roots before source release; park complete parent on close without keeping raw borrower active or violating synchronous C ABI.
Normal/conversion error and ___call/___run rethrow paths need canonical cleanup progress, nested duty, accepted result/error and data-write closure before freeing roots/marker/code.
Actual C pin/retire, source-to-child acceptance, close/park, scan/update/reload and reclaim edges; ordinary C object lifetime, setjmp automatic-local rules and lock adapters still require refinement.

Collector-updateable RootView scanner for every context, nested view lifetime, native borrow exclusion, old-reader pin and relocation reload; processor0 RC scanning does not close arbitrary-owner roots.

callers.actualChain: TclInvokeStringCommand -> proc(clientData) -> scheme_call_cmd -> data_rc -> tcltk_call -> Scheme apply
callers.hazard: Acquire owner-scoped token/entry pin before data_rc, marker or conversion; no callback/GC/layout effect before accepted raw access.
callers.replacement: Token storage lifetime must already cover first hook. Same-owner Tcl dispatch is selected; arbitrary cross-thread Tcl use and saved raw callbacks are excluded.

callers.actualChain: delete traces and imported command deletion -> deleteProc -> hash/Command cleanup
callers.hazard: Close at replacement scheme_delete_cmd first non-reentrant action; return without waiting for pins held by the deleting callback itself. Release payload after pins/results retire.
callers.replacement: Tcl Command reference counts do not defer extension deleteProc or preserve ClientData. Closing before Tcl traces would change allowed reentry; retain pre-deleteProc trace behavior.

callers.actualChain: alloc_rc + still vector -> Tcl_CreateCommand; name conflict invokes old delete; recreated command may be discarded
callers.hazard: Construction transaction must distinguish never installed, installed, displaced and unknown token ownership. Retain tombstones until actual owner/dispatch quiescence.
callers.replacement: CreateCommand return NULL, reentrant replacement and private/raw dispatch remain open routes; no universal drain receipt derived from pins==0.

callers.actualChain: CFUN state materialization -> Tcl_Eval -> callback -> child registration attempt during GC close
callers.hazard: Freeze complete mapped parent locations, stop raw access and preserve native argv/catcher/activation; service only admitted VM wait work, then context seal, reload, same-call retry.
callers.replacement: W_ALL and service_sync_op are source mechanisms, not complete freeze/map/binding receipts. Do not pump Tcl events under the gate or keep a raw borrow while waiting for reopen.

callers.actualChain: thread binding -> program descriptor module thunk -> ___run -> cleanup on nonzero error
callers.hazard: First slice roots the already selected thunk before allocating marker and uses canonical NativeActivation cleanup after END_TRY for every outcome.
callers.replacement: Input source root authority from program descriptor must be proved, not inferred from the C local thunk parameter.

callers.actualChain: thread data_scmobj -> resize synchronization -> ___run_and_throw_error_on_processor_0 -> ___run -> OP_PROCESSOR_0_THROW_ERROR -> sync service loop
callers.hazard: Keep worker source root from thread publication through the pre-___run synchronization loop, root reload, marker allocation and guard cleanup; deliver the original error only after activation retirement is settled.
callers.replacement: start_processor_execution loads thunk before execute_sync_op_loop; a guard only inside ___run does not cover that interval. Thread data_scmobj alone is not a root-scanner proof. Zero/nonzero processors and source handoff remain separate admission obligations.

callers.actualChain: ___call catches then rethrows to ___run outer catcher; inline kill after ___call is skipped
callers.hazard: Root/marker ownership state survives setjmp; after catcher restoration one cleanup claimant invalidates marker, drops owned count once, settles root/result backing, then returns original status.
callers.replacement: Unknown marker decrement cannot be replayed or assumed done. Do not broadly restore arbitrary GVM state or replace language exception/continuation behavior.

allocators.contract: Pin and close share one control domain, token address is stable independently of payload. Pin winner may finish; close winner returns defined adapter rejection without reading payload.
allocators.failure: Delete hook never waits for its own active pin.
allocators.custodian: Last native return/result acceptor owns pin retirement; deferred payload release runs outside control lock.

allocators.actualPath: Extension payload and Tcl Command storage retire at different points
allocators.contract: Payload can retire at closed+zero accepted readers; closed token/tombstone survives already captured or unknown future entry.
allocators.failure: Zero active pins is not owner dispatch drain or interpreter physical destruction.
allocators.custodian: Registry/owner anchor retains token until the selected native producer inventory and quiescence receipt close.

allocators.actualPath: Stop raw writes/reads -> full view freeze -> collector update -> context ready -> reload
allocators.contract: Freeze exact location map and continuation/denv, native activation and same invocation; no raw copies live across the moving epoch.
allocators.failure: Unknown borrower stop refuses freeze and source-ack retirement. A GC-done signal without context-ready/binding/reload is insufficient.
allocators.custodian: Parent retains source until child canonical acceptance; lost ACK queries same activation and keeps overlap.

allocators.actualPath: One exit funnel after outer END_TRY
allocators.contract: VM-owned activation state records root acceptance, marker creation, cleanup claim and error/return intent. No sole progress flag in a modified nonvolatile setjmp local.
allocators.failure: Known marker failure still retires source root. Unknown close/decrement retains root and must be settled from actual progress evidence.
allocators.custodian: Exactly one cleanup custodian; marker invalidation precedes owned count decrement and root release.

allocators.sourceAnchors: setup.c ___run; c_intf.c marker pair; mem.c root scan; gambit.h.in internal declarations
allocators.contract: Introduce the typed per-VM/context activation/root contract and all-context scan adapter; integrate every ___run exit, preserving external signature and error propagation.
allocators.failure: A post-call kill-only patch or unused new API is not this refactor. Source/C-order/native qualification gates remain required.
allocators.custodian: Next consumer is Scheme-generated SFUN; Tcl adapter follows with owner pin/delete/creation semantics. No runtime path retires in this study.

orders.orderContract: Run Tcl interpreter APIs only on their owner thread; use short bridge lock for pin/close versus GC metadata.
orders.rejectedShortcut: GC worker never calls Tcl delete API. No bridge lock held across Tcl/Scheme callbacks or native waits.

orders.orderContract: Preserve Tcl delete traces before deleteProc; close bridge admission at hook entry, publish close before returning.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Changing the public deletion cut to before traces requires separate semantic change, not claimed compatibility.

orders.orderContract: Pin storage and logical open/generation validation precede data_rc read; retirement acquires actual reader/owner-drain evidence.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Command refCount, Tcl_Preserve(interp) and zero payload pins are three different lifetimes. None alone proves token storage safe.

orders.orderContract: Stop raw accesses and complete mapped spills precede release PARKED; collector acquire precedes scan/update.
orders.rejectedShortcut: A root registration or borrower counter decrement without complete view/stop proof does not admit independent scan.

orders.orderContract: Collector relocation and context/binding preparation precede release resume seal; owner acquire reloads mapped roots before same-call use.
orders.rejectedShortcut: No re-evaluation of Scheme inputs, duplicate native invocation or reuse of old raw fp/hp/SCMOBJ copies.

orders.orderContract: Outer catcher restored before canonical cleanup; claim, marker clear, count drop, root retirement and status delivery have explicit progress.
orders.rejectedShortcut: The existing no-allocation kill body is source material for effect qualification, not proof of concurrent atomicity or idempotent decrement.

orders.orderContract: Known cleanup failure retains duty; unknown write/count outcome requires stop/result settlement before reclamation or replay.
orders.rejectedShortcut: C longjmp state and object lifetime must refine actual C ordering; no timeout clears uncertainty.
